answer: We now buy cars that don't run. Some stores will tow your car to the store for free, and your offer page shows which stores near you offer towing. Home pickup isn't available for cars that don't run, and the specialist confirms your offer after inspecting the car at the store. You don't need a payoff letter: Meridian Auto Loans is in our e-payoff network, so we confirm your payoff directly with them the same day at your appointment using your loan account number. Please note we still don't accept flood-damaged cars.
